# TextKDP — Free Text Utilities

> Word counter, Lorem Ipsum generator, and writing tools. Real-time, no signup.

## Tools

- [Word Counter](https://text.kdp.cool/word-counter/): real-time word, character, sentence, paragraph counts; reading and speaking time estimates; most-common word detection.
- [Lorem Ipsum Generator](https://text.kdp.cool/lorem-ipsum-generator/): configurable filler text in paragraphs, words, sentences, or list items.
